content:
Here is the data and context you need to write the thread:

        ASX 200 closed last week at 8,538 points.

        Key themes carrying into the week:
        - RBA meeting on Tuesday 29 July — market pricing ~85% chance of a 25bps cut to 3.85%
        - Inflation data (CPI) due Wednesday 30 July — expected to show continued moderation
        - Big tech earnings in the US (Microsoft, Meta, Apple) due this week
        - Iron ore holding around USD 98 per tonne
        - Gold near USD 3,320 per ounce
        - Oil (Brent) around USD 68 per barrel
        - Australian dollar around USD 0.6430
        - S&P 500 closed last week at 5,636 points
        - US 10-year yield at 4.19%
        - Copper at USD 9,480 per tonne

        Sectors to watch:
        - Banks: sensitive to RBA rate decision and forward guidance
        - Miners: iron ore at USD 98/t is below the key USD 100/t level, copper supportive
        - REITs: rate-sensitive, will react to RBA cut and CPI print
        - Tech/growth: exposed to US big tech earnings sentiment

        Stocks to watch:
        - BHP: iron ore exposure, copper at USD 9,480/t provides offset
        - CBA: most rate-sensitive major bank, key read on RBA impact
        - Goodman Group: REIT bellwether, rate cut would be a tailwind

        

Post 1

ASX 200 at 8,538 — the RBA on Tuesday is the week's line in the sand. Markets price 85% odds of a cut to 3.85%. If the board delivers and signals more, the rally has legs. If guidance disappoints, this level gets tested. #ASX #ausbiz #RBA

Post 2

🏦 Banks hinge on Tuesday's RBA call — CBA leads the rate-sensitivity read. REITs follow Wednesday's CPI; moderation confirms the easing path and lifts property valuations. Two decisions, two days, two sectors on a knife-edge. #ASX #banking #property

Post 3

🔺 Goodman Group is the REIT to watch. A 25bps cut to 3.85% compresses discount rates directly — Goodman is the sector bellwether. If CPI also prints soft Wednesday, the tailwind doubles. #ASX #ausbiz #property

Post 4

S&P 500 closed at 5,636 with Microsoft, Meta and Apple reporting this week. US 10-year at 4.19% keeps the pressure on valuations. A tech earnings beat lifts ASX growth and tech sentiment; a miss hits it hard into Thursday's open. #ASX #ausbiz #SP500

Post 5

Wednesday's CPI is the sleeper risk. A hot print kills the RBA cut narrative — banks and REITs reprice fast. A soft number locks in easing and pushes 8,538 higher. Iron ore at USD 98/t keeps miners cautious either way. Which way are you positioned? #ASX #RBA #inflation
